name: Hyatt Regency Phuket Resort
short_description: A 201-room clifftop Hyatt Regency overlooking Kamala Bay, with one of the largest infinity-edge pools in Phuket.
ai_summary: Hyatt Regency Phuket Resort sits on a hillside overlooking Kamala Bay, built around one of the largest waterfront pools on the island. Guests consistently praise the tranquil, landscaped grounds, attentive staff, and family amenities like Camp Hyatt and a kids' zone, alongside dining spanning Latin-inspired rooftop fare to teppanyaki. Because the resort spans a steep hillside, some guests find a golf cart necessary to reach their rooms, and reviews on the Regency Club Lounge are mixed -- some call it a highlight, others find its limited hours and food selection underwhelming compared with other Hyatt Regency properties.

faqs.question: Is Hyatt Regency Phuket Resort on the beach?
faqs.answer: It's on a hillside overlooking Kamala Bay rather than directly beachfront, with the resort built around one of the largest waterfront infinity pools in Phuket. Because of the steep terrain, getting between rooms and the main facilities sometimes requires a golf cart.

faqs.question: Is the Regency Club Lounge worth it at Hyatt Regency Phuket Resort?
faqs.answer: Reviews are mixed -- some guests enjoy the evening drinks and canapes, while others find the single daily service and limited food selection underwhelming compared with Regency Club lounges at other Hyatt properties, so expectations should be tempered accordingly.
